note: Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated customs/B-L records with HS 100630 (subheadings 10063012, 10063020, 10063092) and B/L numbers 0236686, 6048680, 8449489, 9489407, 8314236, destinations Australia (Fremantle) and Russia (Novorossiysk), Feb–Nov 2025. Declared HS 100630 matches the actual recorded HS codes — no correction needed. Counter discipline: the page claims 29 shipments but only 5 rows were visible in the free view; the 5 rows are quoted as seen, the remaining 24 are unverified. Buyer concentration is notable — the buyer table shows OOO MIOLAR (Moscow) across 31/9/5 records and LUSTRE & LUXE (42 Kathleen Avenue) across 4, i.e. effectively two counterparties, so the export book is narrow and single-market dependent (Russia + Australia). Domestic supply: no traces of domestic deliveries found in accessible sources — this is a data-access gap, not a negative finding, hence 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume figures: null, not public in retrieved sources. No sanctions/court/HS issues to report; company remains in the database.
